resources.string: Start sharing, then open the link on a computer on the same LAN.
Open in Chrome and select Connect. Share the link only with people you trust; it expires when you stop sharing.
The link appears after screen sharing starts.
Share the whole screen or select one app on Android 14+. Each new session requests Android screen-sharing consent.
Optional on Android 10+. Only audio permitted by Android and the source app is captured. In the browser, select Enable sound if asked.
Only sound the source app allows to be shared.
Adjust Fit, Fill, zoom and position in the browser. The phone shares the complete captured frame at up to 30 fps. Protected content may be blank or silent.
Complete the Android sharing prompt. Your browser link will appear here.
